title: Measure Theory

syllabus.details: Classes of sets and measures: Sigma algebras, Borel sigma algebra,measure and its properties (monotonicity, continuity, etc.),Carathéodory's extension theorem, and construction of Lebesgue measure on the real line.
Integration: Lebesgue integration, Monotone, Dominated convergence theorems, Fatou’s lemma, modes of convergence,Egoroff’s and Lusin’s theorems, Lp spaces, Radon-Nikodym Theorem.
Product spaces, product σ-algebras and measures, Lebesgue measure on Rn, the Fubini and Tonelli theorems, change of variable.
Differentiation and integration - functions of bounded variation,absolutely continuous functions, fundamental theorem of calculus for Lebesgue integrals.
